youtube_description:
Exploring the beautiful Illinois Beach State Park! Join us on our camping adventure at campsite 248, near the decommissioned Zion Nuclear Plant. Watch as we hike the Dead River Trail and then switch over to the Dune Trail, enjoying the scenic views along Lake Michigan. Encounter interesting insects and wildlife during our trek. Don't miss out on this nature-filled journey in Illinois! Subscribe for more outdoor adventures and camping trips.

This is Hike #23 of Chicago's 60 Hikes. Adeline Jay Geo-Karis Illinois Beach State Park: Dead River Loop. This is an early video and its fun to see how we've changed our video techniques and ourselves in the last 2 years. The beach in this northern Illinois location both beautiful and wide open. Join us as we discover this gem for camping and beach going. See more at our website: https://www.hike360vr.com/il-beach-state-park-il/
